description: Flat rows for Looker Studio and spreadsheets. dataset "visibility" (default): per day, engine, model, prompt and tracked brand, the successful answers and how many named the brand; failed answers are not counted. "social-pages": per cited social or community page and week, as on Sources › Social pages. "lost-citations": pages cited less or not lately in the 90 days up to "to", as on Sources › Lost citations. Default: the last 30 days; at most 93. Requires the reports:read key permission.
name: get_looker_rows
title: Get looker rows
